correctness.rationale: Proof checks join/meet singleton propagation in synchronous 1-WL; coordinatized quadrangle realizes addition and multiplication (including characteristic two), and extra marks recover all normalized coordinates. Hence the field-generated subplane is singleton. Nonidentity Frobenius fixes marked coordinate field and its projective fixed locus is exactly that subplane. A homology or conjugate Frobenius fixes any four marks, while a fifth field generator makes closure full; this establishes exact minimality for all e>=2. Direct q=4,8,9,16, GF(16)/GF(4) and exhaustive q=4 tests support, not replace, this proof.
